assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness, raising concern for symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.

Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these episodic symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management, consistent with the documented indications.
The service is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry).
The diagnosed condition of atrial fibrillation is coded I48.91.
The diagnosed condition of sick sinus syndrome is coded I34.0.
The diagnosed condition of cardiac arrhythmia is coded I49.5.
The appeal aligns with the medical necessity established in the clinical indication note.
